title: Practice 9: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: This river is dangerous to swim across.
exercises.why: **переплывать** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: переплыть).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Tom got off the plane.
exercises.why: **вышел** — past tense (masculine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: He made me cry.
exercises.why: **довёл** — past tense (masculine) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: Look! The airplane is taking off.
exercises.why: **взлетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of взлетать: imperfective (perfective partner: взлететь).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He passed among the crowd.
exercises.why: **прошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: I married him.
exercises.why: **вышла** — past tense (feminine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: An old woman is walking across the road.
exercises.why: **переходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of переходить: imperfective (perfective partner: перейти).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Fyodor left the building.
exercises.why: **вышел** — past tense (masculine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom has gone out for a walk.
exercises.why: **вышел** — past tense (masculine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom is out of the race.
exercises.why: **сошёл** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Have you gone completely mad?
exercises.why: **сошел** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Tom got out of the limo.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I took the children to school.
exercises.why: **отвёл** — past tense (masculine) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: You crossed over the road.
exercises.why: **перешли** — past tense (plural) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Tom climbed out of the pool.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: We ran around the park.
exercises.why: **обежали** — past tense (plural) of обежать: perfective (imperfective partner: обегать).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Everyone get out of the twilight!
exercises.why: **выйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I've got to get out of here.
exercises.why: **выйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: You have caused me to lose my temper.
exercises.why: **вывел** — past tense (masculine) of вывести: perfective (imperfective partner: выводить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I am losing my patience with you.
exercises.why: **выводишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of выводить: imperfective (perfective partner: вывести).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
